ordered-work.text: First freeze the original exports and state owners. Move options and wallets before the lifetime-sensitive follower, session and confirmation code. Then document and check the candidate.
The diagram places options and wallet below the original facade, with funding and indexing feeding the session and confirmation owners in one direction.

boundary-and-resource-policy.text: Only Node implementation, necessary declarations and imports, focused tests and relevant contributor documentation are in scope. Expensive and cheap command invocations and auditor launches have finite ceilings.
